summary: Release blocker found live by the user during MPI-450. Wan 2.2 with only i2v weights installed still offered t2v_ms; ComfyUI rejected the graph (UNETLoader value_not_in_list on Wan_22_t2v_High/Low) and the 400 surfaced as the REPORT ON GITHUB dialog. Root is availability, not the dialog: per-op deps exist in models.js and deriveInstalledOps already computes the installed-op set, but the PromptBox op strip never consults it. Second defect: a validation rejection must be a toast naming the missing weight, extending MPI-229s _findNodeErrorLora rather than inventing a path. Added to MPI-450 Gate A.

SCOPE DECIDED: gate the mechanism, do NOT split Wan 2.2 into two Library entries. The split would kill this bug for wan-22 but the user confirmed per-op deps are the deliberate design and that MPI-449's MiniMax H3 is the next consumer - one weight set for i2v + t2v, a second for ref2v. Splitting would force deleting operations[].deps, deriveInstalledOps, the op-draft store and the Model Manager UI as dead code, then needing the same thing one release later, plus a permanent migration since installs and history entries carry modelId wan-22. So: fix the availability gate plus the error surface, keep the system. A per-operation Library split, if ever wanted, is a product card of its own and not a bug fix.

todo -> doing. Picked up as the first Gate A build of MPI-450. Scope is the one already decided on the card: gate the availability mechanism (an op whose per-op weights are absent must not be dispatchable) plus the error surface (a ComfyUI validation rejection is a toast naming the missing weight, both engines), and do NOT split Wan 2.2 into two Library entries.

Built. Availability gate: installedOpsForContext + firstInstalledOp in modelRegistry, all three MpiGalleryBlock supportedOps[0] fallbacks reseeded (the remembered op re-checked too), MpiGroupHistoryBlock _opOptions now passes installedOps, and a pre-dispatch gate in commandExecutor beside the MPI-209 arch guard. Error surface: the two carriers moved into js/utils/comfyValidationError.js and a weight rejection now tags weights_missing_local/remote for a toast naming the file. Evidence in validation.md: 9 new tests replaying the real 400 body from app.log, npm test 451 pass, test:desktop 17 pass, eslint clean. Card stays in doing as validating - the reported symptom needs the users machine, where only the i2v weights are installed.

Closed on the user's call 2026-08-08 ('maybe, not sure'), so the gap is recorded rather than dropped: the code is backed by 9 passing tests in tests/uninstalled-op-gate.test.cjs built from a REAL 400 body transcribed out of app.log, including a test that asserts the OLD reader fails on it - but the user has never SEEN the toast fire live, because reaching it needs an op whose weights are genuinely absent. If an uninstalled op ever opens the error dialog instead of toasting, reopen this.
